Name: Greenly
Description:
Greenly is on a mission to democratize access to science-backed climate intelligence, transforming sustainability from a compliance burden into a strategic competitive advantage. 

In a world where sustainability once meant costly consultants, manual data entry, and static PDF reports, Greenly makes climate action accessible, precise, and actionable for everyone: from SMEs to global enterprises. 

Our all-in-one sustainability suite centralizes everything from carbon management and LCAs to ESG & CSRD reporting, backed by 4000+ delivered GHG reports, 10+ ESG frameworks, and a supplier platform engaging over 5,000 partners. Trusted by 3,500 clients in 25 countries, Greenly combines science-backed precision, with access to 300k+ emission factors and methodologies aligned with the GHG Protocol, ISO, and SBTi, with expert guidance from 70+ climate professionals, ensuring every company builds credible strategies and becomes smarter about climate as they go. 

Designed with efficient tech and intuitive UX, Greenly streamlines sustainability operations with integrations across 100+ softwares, automated quality controls, and real-time data visualizations, earning us top ratings (4.9 G2, 4.8 Capterra, 4.6 Trustpilot). 

Greenly empowers companies to own their climate expertise in-house and collectively drive impact toward our bold goal: avoiding 1 billion tons of CO2 by 2030.

Name: Climate Analytics
Description: Climate Analytics is a global climate science and policy institute working to accelerate climate action and keep warming below 1.5°C.

Name: Carbon4 Finance
Description:
Carbon4 Finance is a spin-off of the leading advisory firm Carbone 4 specialized in the energy and climate transition for 18 years.

Carbon4 Finance offers a complete set of climate data solutions covering both physical and transition risks, as well as biodiversity impacts and dependencies.

These proprietary methodologies allow financial organizations to measure the carbon and biodiversity footprint of their portfolio, assess the alignment with a 2°C-compatible scenario and measure the impacts that arise from events related to climate change and biodiversity loss

Name: Hydroclimat
Description:
Hydroclimat: French expertise in climate data engineering for a resilient future in the face of climate change

At Hydroclimat, we are at the crossroads between digital hydroclimatology, artificial intelligence and climate big data. Our mission is clear and aligned with the latest French and European regulations (tracc & csrd ): to provide enriched data for reliable, ultra-precise risk and vulnerability analyses to help industries and local authorities anticipate and adapt to climate change.

 Why Hydroclimat?

Solutions tailored to your needs: With our advanced M3E technology, recognised as DeepTech by BPI France, we combine the most up-to-date scientific data with digital simulations and triple expertise in climate - water resources - flooding. This enables us to develop tools such as POP-Risk, an innovative system for assessing climate-related physical risks.

Solid expertise: We are participating in innovative projects on climate resilience in France alongside CEREMA and @esrifrance, we are previewing Copernicus Climate Change products, and we are contributing to international initiatives such as the WRCP's CMIP7.

A global commitment: Winner of two National Recovery Plans from the cnes and the cnrs , we design solutions like POP-Flood, which help predict floods, for more sustainable and resilient territories.

 Some key figures :

- 200+ climate indicators produced
- 30+ climate models used
- 500TB of climate data
- 25+ scientific publications in 2023
- 3 cifre theses in progress
- 10+ R&D projects

 Our technology for all sectors:

 Finance & Insurance
 Community & Territory
Infrastructures
 Water manager
Agriculture

Name: Weather Trade Net
Description:
Weather Trade Net helps companies and communities identify, measure, anticipate, and mitigate weather-induced loss and damage. Founded in 2022 by Elena Maksimovich, PhD in Climatology and Geophysics, alumna of Pierre et Marie Curie University, Paris-6, the company is driven by a mission to democratize climate risk knowledge and integrate it into sustainability reporting, credit risk modeling, and insurance practices.

At Weather Trade Net, we know that climate risk assessment is more than just data, it’s knowledge for informed decision-making. 

That’s why we are committed to delivering high-quality, user-friendly analytical solutions that transform complex data into actionable insights.

Discover our innovative technology for FREE:
* www.weathertrade.net
* https://climate-audit.ai
* www.yourclimaterisk.com

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCrnBZyU66uYF3sQ7ogG-QWw

Our team of climate scientists and sustainability experts develops technology for instant & easy data access for physical climate risk assessment & reporting. 

We’ve launched the first FREE and self-service platform for global climate risk analytics, providing:
 Decision-level climate data
 Asset-level
 Granular risk scores & probability assessments
 In-depth reports tailored to economic sectors & business needs
 Customized climate & financial impact assessments

As climate regulations and corporate compliance requirements evolve, our technology meets the growing complexity of reporting standards, especially as insurers withdraw from high-risk areas.

What makes us unique?
By integrating DeepTech, ClimateTech, InsurTech, and FinTech, we turn climate data into actionable insights for:
 Asset valuation
 Company ratings
 Credit risk modeling
 Portfolio diversification

In today’s world, climate risk is no longer an abstract uncertainty, it is a quantifiable financial and material factor. Our approach helps businesses adapt, mitigate, and thrive in an era of increasing climate volatility.

Name: Celest.Science
Description:
At Celest.Science, we are dedicated to unlocking adaptive actions in the face of today's changing climate.

We believe in the critical need for forward-looking assessment of climate risks.

By blending AI with climate science, we develop innovative tools that provide our customers with critical insights into water-related risks, ranging from several weeks to a decade ahead.

We are building a team of talented professionals, deeply dedicated to creating meaningful change. Join us in shaping a sustainable future!

- ALEC MVE

Name: Climate Innov
Description: Climate Innov développe des logiciels intelligents d'analyse de risques environnementaux et d'aide à la décision dédiés aux acteurs de la sécurité civile et de la finance climatique

Name: adaptation/s
Description:
A one-stop shop combining predictive tools boosted with artificial intelligence and strategic advisory for positive and resilient adaptation, at scale:
   1. Measure your climate risks across your own sites, supply chain, and business model.
   2. Build adaptation plans based on physical and financial modeling.
   3. Deploy your adaptation strategies at scale to strengthen your business's resilience.

Name: Welow
Description:
Welow offers a cutting-edge platform that empowers banks, fintechs, and retailers to assist their customers in reducing their carbon footprint and embracing sustainable practices.

Using Welow's advanced technological solution and a environmental footprint calculation methodology that aligns with the regulatory standards of ADEME and the European Commission (PEF), the platform efficiently assesses the environmental impact of millions of products and individuals within seconds. This enables businesses and their customers to make more informed choices and actively contribute to a greener future.

Name: RGADATA
Description:
Après 6 ans dans le secteur des assurances, j’ai acquis une conviction : un modèle climatique ne vaut que par la qualité des données qu’il ingère. À l’heure de l’augmentation massive de la sinistralité, l’Open Data et le satellite ne suffisent plus. Pour anticiper, il faut descendre à l’échelle du bâtiment.

Ce que nous faisons chez RGADATA :
Nous sommes le partenaire de données externes qui comble le fossé entre les modèles théoriques et la réalité physique du bâti. Nous aidons les assureurs et les institutions financières à transformer l'incertitude climatique en variables actuarielles exploitables.

Notre Proposition de Valeur :

Identification de Cas d'Usage : Nous ne livrons pas de la donnée brute. Nous définissons avec vous les variables critiques (fondations, végétation, altimétrie) qui impactent réellement vos ratios de sinistralité (S/P).

Collecte & Livraison Industrielle : Nous livrons des datasets structurés, nettoyés et directement injectables dans vos outils SIG ou vos modèles de tarification.

Data Management & Qualité : Nous assurons l'accompagnement nécessaire pour garantir la pertinence et la pérennité de vos modélisations (conformité ESG, CSRD, stress-tests).

L’Innovation RGADATA : La "Vérité Terrain"
Notre force réside dans notre capacité à industrialiser la collecte de données invisibles. En fédérant un réseau d'experts bâtiment (DPE, experts techniques), nous certifions à l'adresse postale les facteurs de vulnérabilité réelle que l'algorithme ne peut que deviner.

Engagement :
Incubés chez Normandie Incubation, nous collaborons avec les leaders du secteur pour bâtir les référentiels de données de demain et maintenir la capacité de souscription en zones sensibles.

Name: SilvaCert
Description:
SilvaCert is a specialist technical advisory firm supporting AFOLU carbon projects and forest-based certification systems.

We provide independent pre-validation, pre-audit, and technical compliance services across leading carbon, forestry, and supply chain standards. Our work strengthens project integrity before formal validation, verification, or certification by accredited bodies.

Our methodology combines scientific precision with practical audit insight. We integrate machine learning, remote sensing, and drone-based applications to analyse large-scale ecological datasets efficiently and accurately. This technical capability enables our senior advisory team to focus extensively on environmental and social safeguards — ensuring that projects are not only carbon-robust, but ethically and ecologically sound.

We support REDD+, peatland restoration, ARR, and jurisdictional AFOLU initiatives, as well as forestry and supply chain certification frameworks. From early-stage due diligence to validation readiness, we provide structured, audit-oriented technical review designed to reduce risk and enhance market confidence.

Our mandate is clear:
Strengthen compliance. Protect credibility. Safeguard long-term asset value.

Name: Azard
Description:
Azard is a climate risk intelligence platform built to help companies move from physical climate risk analysis to concrete adaptation decisions.

We combine climate projections, site-level operational data and transparent impact models to identify where climate risk is material, quantify what it may cost, and prioritise the actions that reduce risk most effectively.

With Azard, teams can:
• Screen portfolios of sites, assets and critical dependencies
• Rank priority hazards, vulnerabilities and business impacts
• Quantify damages, operating losses, cost increases and cost of inaction
• Simulate adaptation scenarios and compare gross vs. net risk
• Estimate the ROI of adaptation measures
• Build and monitor adaptation roadmaps across sites, functions and business units
• Consolidate data for climate reporting and long-term steering

Our platform is designed for climate adaptation teams, sustainability and ESG departments, risk management teams, operational leaders and consultancies working with asset-heavy or multi-site organisations.

Azard is built on three pillars: field reality, climate science and technology. We translate complex physical climate risks into business language: euros, downtime, avoided costs, residual risk, investment priorities and adaptation trajectories.

Because exposure maps and climate scores are not enough. Companies need to know where to act first, how much is at stake, which measures are worth funding, and how to coordinate adaptation over time.

From the site to the Group, Azard helps organisations build a common language to manage climate adaptation at scale.

Book a 30-minute working session with one of our climate risk experts: https://www.azard.io/en/contact/

Name: Climate-Adapt4EOSC
Description: CLIMATE-ADAPT4EOSC project helps researchers in various disciplines to better address climate change in their research by providing an EOSC-centred collaborative research environment that is equipped with existing EOSC data and services and extended with new data and innovative services, such as FAIRification and Mapping and Entity Matching features. The project will develop a climate change adaptation ontology and an EOSC Climate-Adapt Knowledge Graph based on the ontology, which will support findability, accessibility, tracking and life cycle management of different research outputs. The project will magnify the potential of European scientific communities in addressing this grand societal challenge.

Name: SERACLE
Description:
We are an early-stage French climate tech startup, backed by Météo-France, ESA BIC Sud, MakeSense and CentraleSupélec 21st accelerator at Station F. We're also recognized as GreenTech Innovation by the French State.

Our mission? To deliver forward-looking climate data tailored to the unique needs of the energy and building sectors, empowering engineering, business and operations teams to optimize and adapt their assets in the face of climate change.

While much of the industry still relies exclusively on historical weather data to design and operate infrastructure projects—overlooking the shifts in our climate—we leverage the latest advances in climate science and data science to make future climate knowledge accessible and actionable.

We are a Data-as-a-Service platform delivering:
 Next-generation climate datasets, including typical weather files and timeseries, based on the latest climate projections — designed to seamlessly integrate with standard energy studies
(e.g., energy yield assessments, STD/SED).
 Site-specific physical climate risk indicators that evaluate exposure and vulnerability to current and future climate hazards at precise project locations.

Why?
 Immediate impact: Improve profitability, strengthen stakeholder trust, reduce climate risks, and unlock new opportunities.
 Long-term value: Every €1 invested in climate adaptation can yield €2 to €43 in future costs.

Let’s talk!

Name: Climate Contribution Framework
Description:
Measuring corporate climate contribution beyond emissions alone.
The Climate Contribution Framework (CCF) is the first meta-framework designed to assess how companies truly contribute to global net zero, not just through emissions reductions, but through climate solutions deployment and climate financing.

Why it matters:
Ten years after Paris, climate momentum is stalling. Companies lack a fair, comparable way to demonstrate their full climate impact. Investors need robust benchmarks to allocate capital toward real climate leaders. The CCF fills this critical gap.

How it works:
 3 Non-Substitutable Pillars – Reduce (carbon footprint), Scale (climate solutions), Finance (climate investments)
 Sector-Adjusted Fairness – Weightings calibrated across 100+ sectors ensure heavy industry and tech are fairly compared
 Meta-Framework Approach – Builds on existing standards (SBTi, ACT, CDP, EU Taxonomy, etc) without adding complexity
 3 Standardized Outputs – Contribution Potential, Actual Contribution, Contribution Performance

Who it's for:
• Companies – Strategic planning, transparent reporting, recognition for full climate impact
• Investors – Benchmark climate leaders, guide engagement, allocate capital toward measurable impact
• Policymakers & Civil Society – Credible tool for accountability and ambition

Proven credibility:
Initiated by Sweep and Mirova Research Center with the support of I Care by Bearing point and Winrock International. 
Co-developed with 11 major corporations (Accor, Bouygues, EDF, Equans, Eramet, LVMH, Orange, Renault Group, Schneider Electric, Veolia, Klepierre) Overseen by an independent Observer Committee including WBCSD, Ceres, EDF, Value Change Initiative, and others.
Part of the COP30 Action Agenda. Methodology open-source.

Name: OPALimpact
Description:
OPAL is a modular SaaS platform for anticipatory and participatory climate action. It combines climate science, AI, and data engineering with human expertise and local knowledge to help companies, communities, and countries reduce climate impacts across the full climate risk cycle from Observe and Plan to Act and Learn.

While many solutions address only specific parts of the chain risk, OPAL is a modular platform that unifies the entire lifecycle of disaster management. By combining human expertise, Big Data, AI, and Cash Transfers, we help governments and organizations anticipate and respond to climate impacts on infrastructure, populations, and economies. We operate through a hybrid model combining a scalable platform with tailored consulting support.

Name: Grunda
Description: Grunda helps construction materials brands measure the environmental impact of their products through LCAs, certify it with EPDs, and reduce it.

Name: iAoPort
Description:
The iAoPort consortium gathers private and public actors with combined expertise in environmental impacts, maritime activities, and data analytics, working to equip port and marina operators with the necessary tools to measure and control the impact of their activities on air, water and biodiversity.

Combining and analysing video feeds, satellites, physical sensors, and any available sources of data for the port and its environment, iAoPort gives operators the ability to monitor, understand, and ultimately control their impacts and vulnerabilities.

Over time, the iAoPort project aims to become a convenient one-stop solution for the monitoring and smart management of all port operations, mooring zone activity & marine traffic, while mutualising information between local actors, and facilitating communication with other stakeholders.

Name: Catch

Name: Telluriq
Description: With rising resource scarcity and sustainability demands, organizations need resource-conscious management. Our unique blend of data intelligence, advanced analytics, and optimization algorithms enables smarter decisions. By transforming complex data into actionable insights, we empower you to maximize efficiency, reduce waste, and drive sustainable growth.

Name: Earthwise Institute
Description: Earthwise Institute is a research-driven climate intelligence platform, building data and insights on climate technologies, industrial transitions, and climate finance to support decision-making.

Name: climate-switch
Description:
Climate Switch est une société spécialisée dans les prestations d'analyse d'impact climatique, dédiée à aider les entreprises et les particuliers à anticiper et à s'adapter aux effets du changement climatique.

Notre mission est de fournir des analyses précises et personnalisées de l'impact climatique, en utilisant des données et des modèles avancés pour prévoir les risques et opportunités liés au changement climatique. Nous visons à sensibiliser et à équiper nos clients avec les connaissances nécessaires pour prendre des décisions éclairées et durables.

Name: Green Spaces
Description: Green Spaces is a knowledge platform dedicated to advancing sustainable cities, renewable energy, and climate action through research, education, storytelling, and collaboration. We make knowledge more accessible, translate complex ideas into practical insights, and equip people with the tools to build more sustainable, resilient, and inclusive communities. From open educational resources and policy research to visual storytelling and community-driven initiatives, Green Spaces connects ideas, people, and practice to accelerate sustainable development around the world.

Name: La Fréquence du Vivant
Description:
La Fréquence correspond à un ressenti, une sensation ou une vibration. Pour nous, la fréquence se retrouve partout dans le vivant et constitue une manière de ressentir notre environnement.

La vision de La Fréquence du Vivant évolue suivant ces valeurs :
•	Reconnecter positivement l'ensemble des générations au vivant, 
•	Proposer des alternatives au repliement sur soi, 
•	Participer, donner envie d'aller voir, rencontrer le vivant sous toutes ses formes,
•	Sensibiliser, former, démocratiser les nouvelles connaissances autour de la biodiversité et de la bioacoustique.

Name: SereniA
Description:
SereniA is a climate intelligence company specializing in high-resolution multi-hazard baselines, rapid physical risk screening, and physics-informed AI systems to anticipate extreme weather events.

Our dual approach combines:
• POEME (Probability of Occurrence of Extreme Meteorological Events): Sub-seasonal forecasting via atmospheric precursor detection, the critical period when capital is deployed but mitigation remains possible
• IPEME (Impact Potential of Extreme Meteorological Events): Baseline climate risk analytics and asset-level impact indicators, with hazard baseline deployed for Tier-1 Development Banks across 33 countries.

Unlike black-box ML models, SereniA delivers traceable, audit-ready intelligence aligned with IFRS S2, ESRS, and Solvency II governance frameworks.

We serve infrastructure operators (energy, rail), development finance institutions, and insurers transitioning from static risk models to dynamic, decision-ready climate intelligence.

Founded in 2025 and anchored in the European meteorological ecosystem (Météo-France Campus, ECMWF advisors), we operate from Antibes with R&D nodes in Paris and Toulouse.

Contact us for pilot partnerships or baseline risk assessments.

Name: La Mosaïque Hydrogène
Description:
Conçue par Mikaa Blugeon-Mered, spécialiste des marchés et de la géopolitique de l'hydrogène (Sciences Po / UM6P / IFP School...), la MOSAÏQUE HYDROGÈNE est un jeu professionnel innovant, immersif, évolutif et interdisciplinaire qui repousse les frontières des "fresques". 

Avec ses 60 cartes bariolées et son format ludique, la MOSAÏQUE plonge tous les publics — des néophytes aux chevronné.e.s — dans l’univers complet du H2 et de ses dérivés : depuis avant la production jusqu'au-delà des usages  ! 

En équipes de 5 à 8 "mosaïstes", vous explorerez chaque nuance de la chaîne de valeur, en abordant les problématiques techniques mais aussi écologiques, économiques, sociétales, jusqu'à la géopolitique. Cette approche immersive favorise la découverte de nouveaux concepts et nourrit la réflexion stratégique sur les enjeux actuels et futurs de l’hydrogène. 

Pensée pour s’adapter à tous les niveaux de connaissance, la MOSAÏQUE permet, en une matinée, de bien comprendre toute la complexité du H2 : les opportunités qu’il offre pour la transformation écologique comme les risques et les difficultés de la filière.

Moment fort d’échange et d’expérimentation en groupe, la MOSAÏQUE permet aux participant.e.s d’acquérir des compétences spécifiques, des clés de compréhension solides, et de bien se rendre compte de la quantité de planètes à aligner en même temps pour arriver à bâtir une véritable économie de l'hydrogène durable, à l'échelon local comme au niveau mondial. 

Toujours accompagnés d'un.e expert.e. transdisciplinaire, les "mosaïstes" disposent 3 heures 30 pour imaginer, recréer et faire évoluer le système hydrogène : trouver ensemble des solutions durables et concrètes, de la technique jusqu'au politique, sans concessions sur le fond, sur la science, ni sur l'ambiance.

Alors, si vous êtes prêt.e à jouer, contactez-nous !

Name: ClimateShift Intelligence
Description:
ClimateShift Intelligence is a climate intelligence company dedicated to providing actionable insights on climate change to businesses, governments, and organizations worldwide. Our cutting-edge insights and expert analysis help our clients understand the impacts of climate change on their operations, supply chains, and communities. By leveraging our technical capabilities and research methodologies, we provide unbiased opinions on climate trends, risks, and opportunities worldwide.

Our team of experienced climate scientists and ESG experts is committed to helping navigate the complex and rapidly changing climate intelligence landscape. We believe that by providing timely and relevant information, we can help organizations make clear and informed decisions without biases.

At CSI, we are passionate about creating a more sustainable future for everyone. Join us on this journey and let us help you unlock the power of climate intelligence.

Name: Climakin
Description: Climakin empowers businesses to take control of their environmental footprint by tackling the toughest challenge: Scope 3 emissions in complex, global supply chains - using technology and local expertise that drives real-world images.

Name: SUBLIM
Description: Ce service de prévision automatisé, à grande échelle, vise à valoriser les données temps réel des stations hydrologiques et piézométriques en open data et à démontrer la capacité des réseaux de neurones artificiels à produire des prévisions hydrologiques.

Name: Caelyi
Description:
Caelyi is a company specialized in the analysis of climate data. We use Python and its software libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib) to study and analyze climate models and the different ways to mitigate climate warming.

Depending on your needs, we investigate a specific climate issue. For example:

Impact of Covid-19 on GHG emissions

The Kaya identity

China's coal consumption: issues and future

Implications of the new CMIP6 models

Our conclusions are presented in a synthetic report, which can be written in English or in French.

Name: Parallaxe
Description:
Climate data analysis focused on making environmental signals readable and actionable for decision-making.

Current work includes mapping long-term groundwater trends in France, with a focus on transparency, methodology and real-world applications.

Name: Météo Lor'
Description: Météo Lor', association loi 1901 depuis 2013, propose de l'information grand public sur la météorologie, climatologie et environnement.
